I could not run a Monte Carlo code, so these 200 events are hand-generated approximations, not a true random sample. Physically, nearly all interactions here are Compton: at 1.17 and 1.33 MeV in water, photoelectric, pair and coherent interactions are at the 0.1% level or below, so none are expected among 200 events. I split the sample roughly 50/50 between primary photons and once-scattered photons, which is an estimate. Electron directions follow the Compton kinematics, with cos(electron) = [1 + (1+c)/((1−c)(1+α)²)]^(−1/2) and α = E/mc². I did not model second-order scatter or bremsstrahlung.
